feeds.title: The Celiac Scene
feeds.description: The Celiac Scene provides gluten-free restaurants, shopping, products, news, events and deals for Victoria, Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands. We are plugged in to bring you the latest gluten-free news on Vancouver Island posted whenever we have something to report!

feeds.title: Everyday Gluten Free Gourmet
feeds.description: I'm Cinde. On the blog, I share ideas about living your best gluten free lifestyle, need-to-know information about ingredients, recipe round ups and more.

feeds.title: Vancouver with Love
feeds.description: Welcome to Vancouver with Love. Sharing delicious vegan recipes that are gluten-free and refined sugar-free, as well as plant-based guides and travel.

feeds.title: A Canadian Celiac Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Celiac Assoc. is the national voice for people adversely affected by gluten, and is dedicated to improving diagnosis and quality of life.

feeds.title: Gluten-Free Foodee
feeds.description: Gluten-Free Foodee is a blog about living your best gluten-free life with gluten-free food recipes, gluten-free tips and product reviews.

feeds.title: Beyond Flour
feeds.description: Beyond Flour is Marie Porter's ALL Gluten-Free blog. Many recipes posted are featured in her 'Beyond Flour' cookbooks.

feeds.title: Eat Fresh Glow
feeds.description: Hi there! Welcome to Eat Fresh Glow, your go-to destination for wholesome and delicious gluten-free recipes. I'm Jacqui, the creative force behind this blog, and I'm here to share my passion for creating easy-to-make dishes that are not only gluten-free but also free of refined sugars and mostly dairy-free. Recipe inspiration leaves you nourished, satisfied, and energized. Nutrition-dense healthy recipes to fuel your body and keep you glowing.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Edmonton
feeds.description: A guide and resource for gluten free eating in Edmonton, Alberta.

feeds.title: Naturally Gluten-Free Blog
feeds.description: Everything from new recipes, news from the scientific community, travel and restaurant info - all right here in one handy place! Naturally Gluten-Free is about more than just recipes. It's about Strategies. It's about embracing this opportunity to re-build your diet and your life.

feeds.title: GFDF Eating Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jen. I was born and raised in Ontario, Canada. I love creating gluten-free & dairy-free recipes that my family will love. I absolutely love travelling and more recently I discovered a passion for food photography. I am not a trained chef, I just love to bake and help other families with gluten & dairy-free cooking.

feeds.title: The Gluten Free Pug Lover
feeds.description: Reviews on gluten free products, restaurants, travel resorts plus recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Amanda Lynn
feeds.description: We are the makers of gluten-free specialty foods; specializing in perogies! We hand pinch all perogies and make everything from scratch with love and care. We believe that everyone should eat well, love local & say grace!

feeds.title: Only Gluten Free Recipes Blog
feeds.description: Healthy Gluten-Free Family Friendly Recipes. From healthy breakfast to sweet desserts and everything in between for novice cooks & chefs alike.

feeds.title: Prana Foods Blog
feeds.description: From breakfast to late-night snack, we have all the organic & gluten-free tasty foods you need. Let us inspire you to eat more plant-based!

feeds.title: Just Crumbs » Gluten Free
feeds.description: I'm Suzie Durigon. There's easy stuff, sweet stuff, healthy stuff, decadent stuff, re-invented stuff, gluten free stuff, complicated stuff, vegan stuff..., all the food! So, when you're curious about anything food related, you might just find the answer here!!

feeds.title: Toronto Food Safety » Gluten Free
feeds.description: Find posts on gluten-free recipes. Toronto Food Safety Training is a registered provider (TrainCan, Inc.) of food handler certificates. Also, Smart Serve Ontario.
